author: Mark Atwood
text: API contract risk: MEDIUM — calendars-server diverges from the canonical jmap-mail-server template on a half-dozen contract-shaping axes (rustdoc depth on supports_type/update_object/create_object, default-impl philosophy on spec methods, *_for_test methods in published API, crate-root re-export depth, upstream-major-version locks, and absent caps surface). Each individual divergence is fixable without a SemVer break TODAY because the crate is 0.1.1 with no public 0.x.0 release; defer past first stable release and most become SemVer-breaking. The single most consequential finding is JMAP-ic0j.26 (silently-no-oping default impls on spec methods like get_availability and parse_calendar_event_blobs) — a backend author can pass compile + tests while shipping a server that violates draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26 §2.2 / §5.13 by design.
